title: 5 CLAUDE PROMPTS THAT RUN MY 8-HOUR WORKDAY IN 47 MINUTES
description:
47 minutes.
That's how long my hands were on the keyboard during an 8-hour workday.

I was able to claw back 34 hours a week.

Here are the 5 Claude prompts that run the tasks eating up your day. Just Steal them.

One. A morning brief pulling Gmail, Slack, calendar and news into one page. 47 minutes = 4.

Two. Email triage that drafts replies in your voice from your last 5 sent emails. 90 minutes = 11.

Three. A meeting dossier with every past touchpoint plus 3 questions to ask. 30 minutes = 3.

Four. A weekly status report rebuilt from Linear, Notion and Slack that won't fake metrics. 2 hours = 7.

Five. One post turned into a thread, a LinkedIn, a newsletter and an email. 90 minutes = 12.

Claude being smart has nothing to do with it. The prompt shape carries it.

Every one names a role in line one, locks the output format, and ends with a hard stop.
Skip that stop line and Claude fills the session, getting sloppier the longer it runs.
That one line is the difference between a tool and a chatbot that rambles.

One. A morning brief pulling Gmail, Slack, calendar and news into one page. 47 minutes = 4.

Two. Email triage that drafts replies in your voice from your last 5 sent emails. 90 minutes = 11.

Three. A meeting dossier with every past touchpoint plus 3 questions to ask. 30 minutes = 3.

Four. A weekly status report rebuilt from Linear, Notion and Slack that won't fake metrics. 2 hours = 7.

Five. One post turned into a thread, a LinkedIn, a newsletter and an email. 90 minutes = 12.
